about: Augment effects missing from Exiled Exchange 2's item data (upstream/renderer/public/data/en/items.ndjson at the pinned commit). Merged into the price-check engine's augment tables at startup (Engine/engine.ts, applyAugmentSupplement). Each entry adds effects to an item that upstream already knows; tradeId is the stat's first 'rune' id in upstream's stats.ndjson. Checked against poe2db.tw on 2026-11-07. Remove entries once upstream ships them; the engine skips effects upstream already has.
knownGaps: Lesser Tempered Rune, Tempered Rune, Greater Tempered Rune: not in upstream's item data at all (no item record or icon), and Physical Thorns has no rune stat id.
Lesser Charging Rune: not in upstream's item data (higher grades are).
Idol of Silk, Bucklers: 'Companions gain Onslaught when you Parry' has no matching stat in upstream's stats.ndjson.
Soul Cores: not compared yet (poe2db page not fetched).
